'''Wrune Tsallin''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was damaged. After getting it fixed up, Tsallin began working for [[Sprax]] and [[Jatayus Outbound]]. Knowing that he might be late to renew his license at the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], he asked [[Pyrron Nox]] to act as his proxy. However, Tsallin was found dead, floating in the [[Ac'fren Spur]], dessicated and without a [[Environment suit/Legends|vac-suit]]. Hs ship was impounded as recompense for breach of contract with Jatayus.<ref name="SSR" />
